title: Improper certificate validation in Visual Studio allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing… (CVE-2026-118147)
description: CVE-2026-118147 is a vulnerability in Visual Studio involving improper certificate validation. This flaw allows an unauthorized attacker to perform network-based spoofing attacks. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.4, indicating significant impact on confidentiality and integrity but no impact on availability. No affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
